# ADR-3069: A06: Prefer automated dependency update bots for repo 9

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Manual bumps lag behind disclosures.

## Decision

Teams SHOULD prefer automated dependency update bots for repo 9 (A06-9) when patch volume is high.

## Consequences

Bots still require human review.
